criteria.no: No above-100 compliance claim is made, or it has no supporting checkable artifact; exactly 100 does not evidence above-100 capacity.
criteria.unclear: An artifact is mentioned but its support for the capacity claim cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: An identifiable artifact supports a claim of complete stack handling beyond 100 layers.

evidenced.instructions: Does the account link claimed handling of more than 100 stack layers to an identifiable verification or implementation artifact? A specific 101-plus fixture test counts. A topic mention, a bare success claim, or a 100-layer-only test does not.

criteria.no: No such claim is made, the change is deferred, only exactly 100 is tested, or the described behavior rejects or truncates larger stacks.
criteria.unclear: Scalability is mentioned but delivered above-100 support cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The account claims delivered complete support beyond 100 layers, explicitly or through a larger-stack result.

implemented.instructions: Is above-100-layer support present in the described delivered behavior? Look for an explicit capacity statement or complete operation on a stack exceeding 100 layers. A known hard cap or truncation at 100 means no.

criteria.no: The work is unrelated to those operations.
criteria.unclear: The work is too vague to identify its subject.
criteria.yes: The work affects stack capacity, pagination, discovery, request batching, or output.

relevant.instructions: Would the reported work affect processing or displaying a stack beyond 100 layers, including pagination and size ceilings? Judge subject matter only. The required behavior is support for stacks with more than 100 layers in sc-gh-stack.

criteria.no: No incompatible size restriction is described; silence, absent evidence and a test only at 100 do not conflict.
criteria.unclear: A described size restriction is ambiguous about whether larger stacks are supported.
criteria.yes: Explicit delivered behavior rejects stacks above 100 or drops later layers because of a cap.

violated.instructions: Is an explicit delivered decision inconsistent with supporting a stack exceeding 100 layers? Limits that reject larger stacks or truncate their records conflict. Missing evidence and API-budget failure alone do not establish a size violation.

anchor.scope: Chooses size limits, pagination, discovery, request batching, or output handling for stack scripts.
anchor.statement: The sc-gh-stack redesign must support stacks with more than 100 layers.

item.text: Validated stack discovery using tests/test_capacity.py::test_100_layers, which passes for exactly 100 layers. The report makes no claim or observation about any larger stack.
